title: 사이버가정학습 학부모튜터의 역할수행에 영향을 미치는 요인 및 참여동기

abstracts.value: 이 연구는 사이버가정학습의 학부모튜터로 참여하고 있는 학부모의 활동에 영향을 미치는 요인을 분석하고 참여 동기를 알아보기 위한 것이다. 학부모튜터 제도를 시범운영하고 있는 5개 교육청의 학부모튜터를 대상으로 연구를 진행하였으며, 380명의 학부모튜터 설문결과에 근거하고 있다. 학부모튜터의 역할수행에 영향을 미치는 요인을 확인하기 위하여 요인분석을 실시하였으며, 5개의 요인(학생에 대한 이해, 정보소양능력, 정기적인 참여활동, LMS의 활용, 학습지도 및 안내)이 추출되었다. 또한 학부모튜터는 사회봉사, 자녀교육, 상담활동에 가장 높은 참여동기를 보였다. 논의에서는 이러한 학부모튜터에 대한 연구를 바탕으로 높은 역량을 갖춘 학부모튜터를 양성하기 위해서 필요한 양성방안을 논의하였다.

The purpose of this study was to identify parents tutor's role and competencies and to develop the effective training plans for them. In this study, parents tutor was defined as a person who is facilitating students' learning by encouraging, helping, and monitoring students to support the teacher of Cyber Home Learning System. A survey was conducted to identify what factors were hindering parents tutor for those who were doing parents tutor in five districts. For the analysis factor analysis was conducted for 380 parents tutors currently working for each districts. Five factors were extracted from the analysis as hindering parents tutors' activities. Five factors were identified from the survey: 1) Understanding of student, 2) computer literacy, 3) regular participation, 4) use of LMS, and 5) guide for learning. The demographic information of the current parents tutors gave descriptive characteristics for future. Most participants of parents tutor were female at 94.0% and the age range of 70.6% of parents tutors were from late thirties and early forties. This demographic information means that currently working parent tutors will continue to play a key role for the next five years, because their children will be in the school system. Most of parents tutor participating to this study have students at the high grade of elementary school or beginning of middle school The highest ranked motivation of participating to the parents tutor was for their children's academic achievement. This result may reflect that Cyber Home Learning System needs to provide beneficial information for parents tutor to help their children's academic achievement. By providing the information, it would be also possible for the parents tutor to improve their competency for helping their students in the Cyber Home Learning System.
